changelog:
World Cup 2026 Moment-Marketing Engine launched.

- Instantly creates on-brand marketing content for any business based on each day's real World Cup match moments.
- Bridges major game talking points (e.g., upsets, last-minute winners) to different industries with 2–3 creative angle options.
- Produces ready-to-publish posts or short-video scripts tailored for LinkedIn, Medium, blogs, TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts, and more.
- Designed for a wide range of businesses, including restaurants, gyms, e-commerce, agencies, and B2B, while avoiding forced or fabricated connections.
- Strict adherence to real facts, advertising standards, and no official FIFA affiliations for non-sponsors.
